title: Challenges of Evaluating LLM Safety for User Welfare

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the safety of LLM-generated financial and health advice across user profiles stratified by financial fragility (income, debt, savings), education, and occupational backgrounds using context-aware LLM-as-a-judge evaluations.
Assessing the safety of LLM advice for users with specific health barriers, chronic illnesses, mental health conditions, and varying levels of technical literacy.

Comparing context-blind versus context-aware safety scores of LLM advice across holistic user profiles that compound multiple demographic, financial, social, and health factors into low, medium, and high vulnerability tiers.
